'''Teacal''' is a powerful [[Domani]] noble.

== Activities ==
Orders from [[Alsalam Saeed Almadar|King Alsalam]] (secretly under the control of [[Graendal]]) went directly to Teacal and other Domani nobles instead of [[Rodel Ituralde]], sending them in different directions. This led to a number of pitched battles in the night between members of different parts of the same army.{{Ref/book|10|p}}
